<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import json
def snap():
    return current_frame.ascii
def diff(prev, cur):
    p=prev.split('\n'); q=cur.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,p[r][c],q[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if p[r][c]!=q[r][c]]
def glyph_at(r0,r1,c0,c1,fg='B'):
    c=snap().split('\n')
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if c[r][cc]==fg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return [''.join('#' if c[r][cc]==fg else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
# move selection to pos 0
action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print("after 4 LEFT, step:", current_frame.step)
print("blue0:", glyph_at(40,48,12,22))
print("pink0:", glyph_at(51,59,12,22))
s0=snap()
action(['UP'])
d=diff(s0,snap())
print("UP1 diff rows:", sorted(set(x[0] for x in d)))
print("blue0:", glyph_at(40,48,12,22))
print("pink0:", glyph_at(51,59,12,22))
s1=snap()
action(['UP'])
d=diff(s1,snap())
print("UP2 diff rows:", sorted(set(x[0] for x in d)))
print("blue0:", glyph_at(40,48,12,22))
print("pink0:", glyph_at(51,59,12,22))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

import json
def snap():

def diff(prev, cur):
    p=prev.split('\n'); q=cur.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,p[r][c],q[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if p[r][c]!=q[r][c]]
